name: Randall Lough
summary: Senior full-stack product engineer who is comfortable moving between stacks to solve the problem in front of me. I enjoy work that starts without a clear path and calls for investigation and careful tradeoffs. My current interest is in AI, both in the products I build and in how engineering teams work with it. I use it to move faster and smarter.

experience.overview: Shopify storefront and custom Shopify Admin app.

positions.title: Torrey Pines Golf Course
responsibilities: Rebuilt the storefront on Shopify Hydrogen, covering catalog, search, cart, customer accounts, and checkout.
Built a CMS as a Shopify Admin app, so staff edit storefront content in the admin they already use.
Set up agent-assisted development with repo rules and custom lint gates on commit, push, and CI that hold agent output to human standards.
Added Storybook and Playwright end-to-end tests for cart, product, and checkout.

positions.title: Appraisal Desk
responsibilities: Designed and built an inspection scheduler where appraisers could view, create, and edit inspections.
Defined the testing strategy across unit, integration, and Playwright end-to-end tests.
Built GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines that supported daily production releases.

experience.overview: Software agents, backed by human operators, handling everyday tasks for members.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Rebuilt the signup flow across web and native apps, covering account creation, checkout, and activation.
Instrumented the signup funnel so the team could find drop-off points and verify changes in conversion.
Updated the member chat interface for conversations with Duckbill's AI agent and added support for task-specific widgets.
Introduced AI-assisted coding workflows for the frontend: verification loops, lint rules, and Playwright end-to-end tests.
Built an internal documentation site covering triage, on-call, system behavior, and engineering practices, with AI workflows that kept it current as the codebase changed.

experience.overview: Fintech company with project-based charge cards, AI automations, and conversational tools.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
responsibilities: Led frontend for a company-wide redesign: built a documented component library and an HTMX request pattern for SPA-like navigation, working with design and product.
Planned and built Zena's AI agent chat UI from proof of concept through implementation. It became the base for every AI conversation in the product.
Replaced a static tool architecture with a typed object structure for defining tools, so AI agents could support a wider range of them.
Designed an entitlements system covering numeric limits and permissions, not just on/off feature flags.

positions.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Added OpenSearch-backed search for imported transactions.
Added GraphQL schema validation to CI and standardized error handling.
Started Zena's on-call program and refined the process before more engineers joined the rotation.
Presented the team's GraphQL-versus-REST architecture options and tradeoffs.
Ran weekly engineering retrospectives.

experience.overview: Employee benefits platform with self-service tools and AI-assisted underwriting.

positions.title: Software Engineer
responsibilities: Led a TypeScript and Next.js frontend rewrite that cut feature development cycles by 40%, and helped the engineering team adopt both.
Built an internal Go CLI used company-wide for developer workflows, such as setting up services and updating dependencies, with tests and a CI/CD pipeline.
Mentored junior engineers in Go and system design.

experience.overview: Cloud-based back-office platform for order, inventory, and warehouse workflows.

positions.title: Marketing Manager and Web Developer
responsibilities: Built and launched the company's custom marketing site from scratch, saving tens of thousands of dollars and improving its mobile experience and conversion funnels.
Ran a multichannel marketing strategy that grew organic search traffic 35% month over month.
Increased demo requests 840% and contract generation 1,500% through coordinated content campaigns.
Produced blog posts, ebooks, case studies, videos, webinars, and paid ads for lead generation.

projects.name: Just Plain Coffee
projects.description: An ecommerce app that sells coffee beans and merch using React and Shopify.
items: Built a headless Shopify storefront on Hydrogen, React Router 7, and TypeScript, with catalog, search, cart, accounts, orders, and subscriptions.
Built type-safe Storefront and Customer Account API integrations with GraphQL code generation.
Built the UI with Tailwind CSS, Base UI, and Storybook, with colocated stories and accessibility checks.
Established a pnpm/Turborepo monorepo with automated formatting, type-aware linting, type checks, Git hooks, and production build validation.

projects.name: Camelot
projects.description: A multi-tenant iOS app that allows parents to track their child's daily activities.
items: Built a SwiftUI iOS 26 app for tracking feeding, sleep, diapers, and daily check-ins, with SwiftData storage. Times are stored in UTC and shown in the child's time zone.
Built private sharing on CloudKit with a zone-wide CKShare per child and invite-only access. Caregivers' private check-ins stay in a separate zone and are never shared.
Wrote a CKSyncEngine sync layer for private and shared databases, with last-writer-wins conflicts, delete tombstones, and model work on a background ModelActor.
Added a sleep Live Activity pushed to other caregivers' Lock Screens through a Cloudflare Worker relay. Added Maestro end-to-end tests and TestFlight builds from version tags.

projects.name: Don't Forget
projects.description: A collaborative, multi-tenant iOS app that works offline.
items: Built the app as a full-stack TypeScript monorepo with an Expo/React Native iOS client, a Hono API, a TanStack web app, shared Zod contracts, and Drizzle/Postgres storage.
Used PowerSync and OP-SQLite for offline list and item updates, reactive queries, and background sync. Added tombstones and last-writer-wins conflict handling.

Built household sharing with Clerk authentication, membership-scoped replication, server-side row authorization, and role-based permissions. Members can join through invitations or reusable household codes.
Added React Native Storybook to QA screens and component states in isolation before testing them in the app.

projects.name: Resume Builder
projects.description: A Go resume builder that turns JSON into an ATS-friendly LaTeX resume.
items: Built a Go pipeline that loads version-controlled JSON into typed models, renders a Go template to LaTeX, and compiles the PDF with LuaTeX inside Docker.
Wrote a Goldmark AST renderer that converts Markdown cover letters to LaTeX, including headings, emphasis, code, links, and nested lists.

projects.name: PGX Scan
projects.description: A PGX plugin that maps SQL query results to Go structs.
items: Maintained a Go library that extended PGX with direct scanning from query results into Go structs and custom data types.
Added JSON column support, nested struct scanning, and configurable join-table column notation.

education.degree: Bachelor of Science in Business Administration
